notes: SMTP and IMAP reply signatures for the code-owned email route (design 2.3.1, 4.5). The regex in 'smtp' is matched case-insensitively against '<reply code> <reply text>' (IMAP: the error text). Same regex rules as linkedin.json.

signatures.smtp: ^535|5\.7\.[0-9]+|authentication failed|application-specific password required|username and password not accepted
